papers.title_zh: 成人难治性哮喘的性别表型差异：男性肺功能更差、全身炎症更强，女性心身共病与多病共存更重，但总体疾病严重度两性相似
papers.title_en: Sex differences in the clinical phenotype of difficult-to-treat asthma in adults.
papers.authors: Ahsan Z, Freeman A, Moyses HE, Charles D, Ainsworth B, Wei L, Michael Haitchi H, Eames C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Clinical and Experimental Sciences, Faculty of Medicine, University of Southampton, UK.
papers.results: 多变量回归模型中，男性血清IgE更高（ratio 1.95, 95% CI 1.19 to 3.20），FEV1更差（effect -9.98, 95% CI -15.21 to -4.74），鼻息肉更常见，血浆IL-17、TNF-α、CCL3、CCL11及YKL-40表达更高；女性BMI更高，血浆脂肪因子（ratio 1.25, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.37）及IL-5（effect 3.52, 95% CI 2.65 to 4.39）更高，多病共存负担（score effect 0.60, 95% CI 0.29 to 0.92）、焦虑/抑郁及诱发性喉气管功能障碍（odds ratio 2.38, 95% CI 1.20 to 4.76）更多，Hull咳嗽高敏感、Nijmegen及SNOT自评评分更差。治疗与医疗资源利用、综合哮喘严重度评分未见性别差异。
papers.authors_conclusion: 性别影响难治性哮喘表型，但两性所关联的不同因素最终对应相似的总体疾病严重度；男性肺功能与全身炎症更差，女性心身共病及多病共存负担更重；临床识别并考虑这些差异、精细化调整管理，或可改善难治性哮喘结局。
papers.ai_note: 属单中心横断面/观察性关联分析，因果方向不明；难治性哮喘定义与纳入路径未在摘要交代，存在转诊偏倚与人群限定松动风险；多变量模型校正变量清单未在摘要给出，混杂控制情况信息不足；多数细胞因子仅列方向而无具体数值，选择性报告；无外部验证队列。

pico.p: 英格兰南部难治性（difficult-to-treat）成人哮喘患者500例，按性别分组（男性 vs 女性）
pico.ic: 非干预性研究，比较男性与女性难治性哮喘的人口学、治疗史、过敏、共病、影像、生物样本、肺功能及问卷指标

papers.reason: 为难治性哮喘的个体化管理提供性别维度的表型基线，说明两性可能需不同共病筛查与干预重点（男性侧重气流受限与中性粒细胞性炎症，女性侧重心身共病与ILO），亦可作为胸部呼吸病队列设计中性别分层的参考对照。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Sex disparity has been demonstrated within difficult-to-treat (difficult) asthma, with females reported to have greater disease severity and more comorbidities. Deeper understanding of these differences could help personalise management approaches. OBJECTIVE: To assess differences in disease characteristics between males and females with difficult asthma. METHODS: The Wessex AsThma CoHort study collected data from 500 patients across Southern England. Patient demographics, asthma and its treatment history, allergies, comorbidities, radiology, biological samples, lung function, and questionnaire data were subjected to univariable analyses to identify sex differences. Variables were then further assessed in multivariable regression models. RESULTS: Males were older at disease onset and were more often ex-smokers. In multivariable regression models they had higher serum immunoglobulin E (ratio 1.95, 95% CI 1.19 to 3.20) and plasma inflammatory cytokine expression (interleukin-17, tumour necrosis factor - alpha, C-C motif ligands 3 and 11 and chitinase 3-like 1). Males had poorer lung function (forced expiratory volume in 1 second effect -9.98, 95% CI -15.21 to -4.74) and more frequently had nasal polyps. Females had higher Body Mass Index, and in multivariable regression higher plasma adipokine (ratio 1.25, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.37) and interleukin-5 expression (effect 3.52, 95% CI 2.65 to 4.39), multimorbidity burden (score effect 0.60, 95% CI 0.29 to 0.92), anxiety/depression, and inducible laryngeal obstruction (odds ratio 2.38, 95% CI 1.20 to 4.76). They self-reported worse Hull Cough Hypersensitivity, Nijmegen and Sino-Nasal Outcome Test scores. We observed no difference in treatment and healthcare utilisation, or composite asthma severity score. CONCLUSION: Sex influences difficult asthma phenotype but contrasting factors are associated with similar overall disease severity in both sexes. Males have worse lung function and systemic inflammatory profiles, whilst females experience greater psychophysiological comorbidity and multimorbidity burden. Recognising differences and considering them clinically to fine-tune management may help improve difficult asthma outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 鼻腔压力潮气呼吸模式诊断气流受限的准确性低于肺功能检查（敏感度66%、特异度63%）
papers.title_en: Diagnostic Accuracy of Tidal Breathing Patterns in Assessing Airflow Obstruction Compared with Spirometry.
papers.authors: Dörssers BJMH, Vaes AW, Hagmeijer R, Broekhuijsen-Godding MHJM, Franssen FME, van Putten DS, Spruit MA, Simons SO et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Research and Development, Ciro, Horn, The Netherlands.
papers.results: 鼻压分析检出气流受限敏感度66%、特异度63%、准确率64%；Bland-Altman分析两法测量差异均值-0.016，95%一致性界限-0.43至0.40；两法均在192例受试者完成
papers.authors_conclusion: 鼻压分析检出肺功能定义的气流受限表现中等，提示其作为无创工具的潜力有限；仍需进一步研究以确定其可能的临床应用价值
papers.ai_note: 研究人群为肺功能室转诊患者而非预期应用的初级保健人群，存在谱偏倚（疾病谱与患病率与基层筛查场景不一致），敏感度/特异度外推性受限；摘要未报告敏感度、特异度的置信区间及ROC/AUC，仅凭点估计难以评估精度；准确率64%受样本患病率影响，信息不足无法校正；未与现有低成本筛查手段（问卷、指氧等）比较；作为诊断准确性研究未提供样本量估算依据

pico.p: 因常规肺功能检查转诊的192例受试者（中位年龄66岁，IQR 56-74；男性39%）
pico.ic: 鼻腔压力变化分析推算的FEV1/FVC（AMES BV装置）对照肺功能检查测定的FEV1/FVC（参考标准，FEV1/FVC<0.70定义气流受限）

papers.reason: 评估低负担COPD筛查装置的诊断性能，为基层气流受限筛查工具选择提供直接证据；中等性能结果可避免临床上对替代性无创筛查的过度期望，同时提示未来诊断准确性研究在目标人群与统计报告上的设计要求
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Spirometry is the standard for assessing airflow obstruction in COPD, but low-burden screening tools may support primary care in identifying patients needing referral, potentially enabling earlier diagnosis and timely disease management. A novel, easy-to-use device (AMES BV, the Netherlands) estimates obstruction from nasal pressure variation during tidal breathing and may support referral decisions. This study aimed to assess the ability of nasal pressure analysis to identify airflow obstruction compared with spirometry. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Cross-sectional study at a hospital pulmonary function laboratory. In a convenience sample of participants referred for routine spirometry, nasal pressure variation was measured via a nasal cannula and converted into an obstruction index, expressed as an estimated Forced Expiratory Volume in the first second/Forced Vital Capacity ratio (FEV1/FVC). The ability to identify spirometry-derived obstruction (FEV1/FVC<0.70) was assessed by sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy, with spirometry as reference standard. Bland-Altman plots were used to assess agreement between the estimated FEV1/FVC ratio (derived from nasal pressure variation) and spirometry-defined FEV1/FVC ratio. RESULTS: Both procedures were performed in 192 participants (median age 66 (IQR 56-74) yrs; 39% male). Nasal pressure analysis showed moderate performance in detecting obstruction (sensitivity 66%, specificity 63%, accuracy 64%). The Bland-Altman plot showed variability between both measurements, consistent with moderate classification performance, with a mean difference of -0.016 and 95% limits of agreement ranging from -0.43 to 0.40. CONCLUSION: Nasal pressure analysis showed moderate performance in detecting spirometry-defined airway obstruction, suggesting limited potential as a non-invasive tool. Further research is needed to establish its possible clinical utility.

papers.title_zh: 肥胖相关指标与COPD患者住院急性加重的性别分层关联：一项回顾性横断面研究
papers.title_en: Obesity-Related Indices and Hospitalized Acute Exacerbation in COPD Patients: Sex-Stratified Associations from a Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study.
papers.authors: Qin M, Qiao M, He W, Yang H, Xu X, Guo X
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Nursing, Shandong Xiehe University, Jinan, Shandong, 250000, People's Republic of China.
papers.results: 住院AECOPD总体患病率27.3%，男女间无显著差异（P=0.74）。8种指标均与住院AECOPD正相关（所有P<0.01）。女性：AVI AUC最高0.764，CI 0.747，BRI 0.730，均经Holm校正后显著高于BMI。男性：VAI AUC数值最高0.705，BRI 0.687，LAP 0.676，仅BRI显著高于BMI（P=0.022）。性别×AVI交互作用经校正后仍显著（P=0.011）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 所有8种肥胖相关指标均与住院AECOPD正相关，且判别能力存在性别差异。女性中AVI的AUC最高且经校正后优于所有其他指标，男性中VAI AUC数值最高但多数差异未达统计学显著。这些发现提示反映体脂分布的精细人体测量指标值得进一步研究作为AECOPD潜在标志物。
papers.ai_note: 横断面设计无法建立因果关系或时序性。对照组为因非加重原因住院的COPD患者，引入住院人群内的选择偏倚（Berkson偏倚），结论仅适用于住院COPD人群，不可外推至一般COPD患者。各指标AUC均在0.68–0.76范围内，判别能力有限，对BMI的增量价值不大。作者结论相对谨慎（'warrant further investigation'），未过度宣称。

pico.p: 中国西部某综合医院住院COPD患者968例（男529例，女439例）
pico.ic: 8种肥胖相关指标（BMI、WHR、BRI、CI、BAI、AVI、LAP、VAI）；对照为因非急性加重原因住院的COPD患者

papers.reason: 为COPD急性加重风险评估中肥胖指标选择提供性别分层的初步证据，对肥胖与COPD管理的科研设计（如前瞻队列选择暴露指标）有参考价值；与胸科肿瘤业务关联度低。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Obesity is a major risk factor for adverse prognosis in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD); however, the associations of obesity-related indices with acute exacerbation of COPD (AECOPD) and the potential sex differences therein remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the sex-specific associations between multiple obesity-related indices and the prevalence of hospitalized AECOPD. METHODS: This retrospective cross-sectional study included 968 COPD patients (529 males, 439 females) admitted to a comprehensive hospital in Western China. Eight indices were examined: body mass index (BMI), waist-to-hip ratio (WHR), body roundness index (BRI), conicity index (CI), body adiposity index (BAI), abdominal volume index (AVI), lipid accumulation product (LAP) and visceral adiposity index (VAI). The outcome was AECOPD requiring hospitalization; patients hospitalized for non-exacerbation reasons formed the comparison group. Logistic regression (crude, minimally adjusted, fully adjusted) assessed the associations. Additionally, sex-by-index interactions were tested in the pooled sample with Holm adjustment for multiple comparisons. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses were performed to evaluate the discriminative ability of the indices, including comparisons of the area under the curve (AUC) between indices (DeLong tests with Holm adjustment). RESULTS: The overall prevalence of hospitalized AECOPD was 27.3%, with no significant difference between males and females (P=0.74). All eight indices were positively associated with hospitalized AECOPD in both sexes (all P<0.01). In females, AVI had the highest AUC (0.764), followed by CI (0.747) and BRI (0.730), all significantly higher than BMI after Holm correction. In males, VAI had the numerically highest AUC (0.705), followed by BRI (0.687) and LAP (0.676), but only BRI was significantly higher than BMI (P=0.022). Only the sex-by-AVI interaction remained significant after correction (P=0.011). CONCLUSION: All eight indices were positively associated with hospitalized AECOPD, with sex-specific discriminative ability. In females, AVI had the highest AUC and outperformed all other indices after correction, whereas in males VAI had the numerically highest AUC, but most differences were not statistically significant. These findings suggest that refined anthropometric measures reflecting body fat distribution warrant further investigation as potential markers of AECOPD.

papers.title_en: VAPA-dependent lipid transport at ER-lamellar body contact sites promotes human lung surfactant formation.
papers.authors: Grimanelli Z, Dadsena S, Meichsner F, Hipp L, Altuzar J, Bo J, Singh K, Abélanet S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Université Côte d'Azur, Inserm, CNRS, UMR 7275, Institut de Pharmacologie Moléculaire et Cellulaire, 660 route des lucio…
papers.authors_conclusion: Our findings establish VAPA-dependent MCS dysfunction as a mechanism of syndromic lung disease and define a pathway for surfactant lipid trafficking.
papers.ai_note: 证据等级为单例患者加细胞/分子实验，无对照队列、无定量数据、无统计学指标；机制结论（VAPA-ABCA3互作、ER-LB接触位点）在摘要中无定量支持，信息不足以评估稳健性；结论外推至'人类肺表面活性物质形成通路'存在人群限定松动。与成人胸部肿瘤/胸外科临床实践关联较弱。

pico.p: 一例携带VAPA纯合无义变异p.(Glu12*)的患者及人肺泡Ⅱ型细胞模型

papers.reason: 为肺表面活性物质缺陷与胆固醇肺炎/肺纤维化的遗传机制提供新候选通路（VAPA-ABCA3），可供间质性肺病与罕见肺病科研参考；不改变胸肿瘤领域临床决策。
papers.abstract_en: Vesicle-associated membrane protein-associated proteins (VAPs) establish membrane contact sites (MCS) between the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and other organelles through interactions with FFAT-containing proteins, coordinating lipid synthesis, transfer, and metabolism. Their tissue-specific functions remain poorly understood. We report a patient with a homozygous nonsense variant in VAPA (p.(Glu12∗)), presenting with profound global developmental delay and progressive surfactant dysfunction leading to cholesterol pneumonitis and pulmonary fibrosis. Alternative translation initiation partially bypasses the premature stop codon, producing an N-terminally truncated VAPA protein with impaired FFAT binding capacity and disrupted lamellar body (LB) formation in human alveolar type 2 cells. We identify the pulmonary disease-associated ATP-binding cassette transporter A3 (ABCA3), a regulator of surfactant lipid accumulation, as a VAPA interactor. VAPA-ABCA3 interaction facilitates lipid exchange at previously uncharacterized ER-LB MCSs, a function lost upon VAPA truncation. Our findings establish VAPA-dependent MCS dysfunction as a mechanism of syndromic lung disease and define a pathway for surfactant lipid trafficking.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by acute exacerbations that frequently result in hospitalization, highlighting the need for improved follow-up care. Hybrid care incorporates digital health strategies such as remote patient monitoring (RPM). This could offer the opportunity to detect early signs of disease worsening by remotely tracking selected health indicators. However, it is unknown how RPM can effectively be integrated into current practice. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to cocreate a theoretical hybrid COPD care pathway integrating RPM into the existing care trajectory, considering the expertise of participating care pathway stakeholders. METHODS: This 2-phase study was conducted between May and August 2025. At first, semistructured interviews were conducted with stakeholders (ie, patients and health care professionals [HCPs]) involved in COPD care to map the existing care pathway in a single tertiary care hospital in Belgium. Patients were approached during hospitalization based on predefined eligibility criteria, whereas HCPs were recruited through convenience sampling. In phase 2, patient representatives and HCPs were recruited through patient-organization networks and professional referral, respectively, using convenience sampling, and participated in separate interactive workshops. These workshops reviewed existing care pathway phases and HCP roles and explored the integration of RPM, including timing, duration, implementation, data monitoring, and follow-up responsibilities, to codevelop a theoretical hybrid care pathway. Interview and workshop data were independently reviewed by 2 researchers to extract information on care pathway elements, stakeholder roles, limitations, and proposed adaptations. Findings were organized according to the relevant care pathway phase, independently summarized and compared, with discrepancies resolved through discussion and consensus. Interview findings informed the development of an initial infographic representing the existing care pathway, which was subsequently adapted based on workshop findings to represent the proposed cocreated theoretical hybrid care pathway. RESULTS: In total, 10 stakeholders participated in the interviews (5 patients and 5 HCPs), and 6 stakeholders participated in the workshops (3 patient representatives and 3 HCPs). The existing COPD care pathway involves multiple stakeholders whose activities can be organized into 5 functional domains: support, treatment, medical advice, patient education, and monitoring. Stakeholders can be divided into hospital-based, community-based, or cross-setting. The workshop participants identified the need for a stakeholder dedicated to RPM activities in order to integrate RPM strategies into the care pathway. This individual could be responsible for all RPM-related activities (ie, RPM device installation, providing RPM-related education, data review, alert management, and RPM discontinuation) and could serve as the bridge between patients and physicians, ensuring close communication. CONCLUSIONS: This study resulted in a cocreated theoretical hybrid COPD care pathway. Stakeholders highlighted the potential value of a dedicated RPM role to coordinate and deliver RPM activities as part of the COPD care pathway. Further research is needed to assess its feasibility and clinical applicability.

papers.title_en: Mobility as a proxy for exposure to Mycobacterium tuberculosis in an African city with endemic tuberculosis.
papers.authors: Yang H, Yao A, Quach THT, Zalwango S, Kakaire R, Kiwanuka N, Whalen CC
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Geography, University of Georgia, Athens GA, United States.
papers.authors_conclusion: The heterogeneity in the mobility of tuberculosis cases suggests that a single strategy to reduce transmission of tuberculosis may not suffice. Instead, future interventions should address the variable patterns of case mobility in the community.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足之处较多：①以移动性作为暴露与传播的“proxy”，但摘要未报告该代理指标与实际传播/感染结局（如接触者感染、IGRA转阳、二代病例）的任何验证，代理效度无证据；②标题与摘要称量化exposure与transmission，实际仅描述移动性分布，未给出传播量化结果；③BERT4Traj为“novel”算法，摘要无轨迹估计精度、误差或与金标准（如GPS/实地随访）的验证指标；④全文无任何异质性的统计量（无离散度指标、无P值/CI），异质性结论为定性描述；⑤“单一干预策略不足、应针对可变移动模式干预”的推论超出数据——移动性异质性本身不能证明干预效果差异；⑥单城市、191例，人群外推性有限；④社会人口学特征仅称“partially explained”，无具体关联数值。

pico.p: 坎帕拉（乌干达）191例培养确诊结核病病例；当地结核病患病率750例/100,000人口
pico.ic: 无对照组（观察性描述研究）；以病例传染病期内手机通话详单（CDR）经BERT4Traj算法估计地理轨迹并计算移动性指标

papers.reason: 为胸部传染病（结核）社区传播研究提供暴露量化方法学参照：展示手机CDR+AI轨迹在传染病期活动范围刻画中的可行性与局限，可为结核队列/接触者研究设计中移动性指标的引入与验证需求提供参考；同时提示代理终点研究的证据强度边界
papers.abstract_en: Tuberculosis remains a serious disease that persists around the world today because of ongoing transmission of Mycobacterium tuberculosis among cases and their contacts in the community. To curb the tuberculosis epidemic, new strategies are needed to reduce transmission in the community. Since quantifying exposures and transmission in a dynamic community is difficult, we propose that the mobility of a case during the infectious period may be a proxy measure of exposure and subsequent transmission. In a study performed in Kampala, Uganda, where the prevalence of tuberculosis disease was 750 cases/100,000 population, we collected cellular telephone call-detail records from 191 culture-confirmed tuberculosis cases and used a novel artificial intelligence algorithm, BERT4Traj, to estimate geographic trajectories of each case and characterized their mobility using metrics derived from the trajectories. We found that mobility of cases was both spatially and temporally heterogeneous. Some cases traced spatial patterns that bridged various locations and expanded their contact networks, whereas others traced regular movements that led to repeated contacts. This heterogeneity was partially explained by socio-demographic characteristics of the cases. The heterogeneity in the mobility of tuberculosis cases suggests that a single strategy to reduce transmission of tuberculosis may not suffice. Instead, future interventions should address the variable patterns of case mobility in the community.

papers.title_en: An automated EEG-ECG framework for CAP-HRV analysis: enabling brain-heart coupling studies in sleep disorders.
papers.authors: Shukir S, Moussa M, AlZaabi Y, Khandoker A, Struzik ZR
papers.affiliation_highlight: Healthcare Engineering Innovation Group (HEIG), Department of Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology, Khalifa Universi…
papers.results: 示例研究在 OSAD+ 亚组（n=18）演示了CAP与非CAP epoch的框架输出；健康睡眠A1事件HRV参考值来自公开CAP Sleep数据库（15名对照，785个A1 epoch），作为描述性跨数据库参考。摘要未报告任何统计学比较数值、效应量、CI或P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: 该框架提供了可复现、规则化、模块化的睡眠微结构与自主神经动力学整合EEG-ECG分析工具；通过在同一环境中实现同步CAP-HRV特征提取，降低了睡眠脑-心耦合研究的工程门槛，并为后续扩展（经验证的CAP检测、匹配对照研究、Python移植、云端部署）奠定基础。
papers.ai_note: 主要局限由作者自述但仍需强调：CAP A1检测仅为已发表评分标准（Terzano）的规则化实现，尚未与专家人工评分对标，摘要中无任何敏感度/特异度/一致性（如kappa）指标，即该管线的核心环节缺乏准确性验证；HRV部分依赖直接调用PhysioZoo/mhrv，非本研究验证内容。示例（n=18）与参考数据（n=15）均为描述性展示，无统计推断，属纯方法学框架论文，临床结论不可外推。信息不足：无与现有睡眠分析软件的运行效率或可重复性量化比较。

pico.p: 示例演示人群为 OSAD+ 亚组 n=18；参考数据来自公开 CAP Sleep Database（15名健康对照，785个A1 epoch）
pico.ic: 无干预与对照（工具开发研究；框架内 CAP-A1 规则化检测 + PhysioZoo/mhrv 直接调用的 HRV 特征提取，比较对象为各模块在CAP与非CAP epoch的输出及跨数据库描述性参考）

papers.reason: 作为方法学工具论文，可为睡眠障碍脑-心耦合科研设计提供开源流程参考；但因核心CAP检测环节未经验证且无临床结局数据，对胸科/肿瘤临床决策无直接影响，仅限于睡眠生理研究方法层面的借鉴。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Multimodal sleep analysis typically requires separate processing pipelines for electroencephalography (EEG) and electrocardiography (ECG), which complicates joint investigation of sleep microstructure and autonomic regulation. Cyclic alternating pattern (CAP) scoring and heart rate variability (HRV) analysis are routinely performed in different software environments, limiting temporal alignment, reproducibility, and scalability. METHODS: We present an open-source MATLAB framework that integrates rule-based CAP A1 detection and HRV feature extraction within a single, time-synchronized workflow. The pipeline performs standardized EEG and ECG preprocessing, rule-based CAP A1 detection during slow-wave sleep (SWS) implementing the Terzano scoring criteria, R-peak detection via the Pan-Tompkins algorithm, and computation of time-domain, frequency-domain, and nonlinear HRV features by calling the open-source PhysioZoo/mhrv toolbox directly. CAP annotations are aligned with 5-minute ECG epochs through the shared polysomnography (PSG) time base. The complete code is released as an open-source repository to support reuse and extension. RESULTS: Because HRV features are computed by calling the PhysioZoo/mhrv toolbox directly, the pipeline introduces no reimplemented HRV routine and inherits that toolbox's validated feature definitions. CAP A1 detection is provided as a rule-based implementation of published criteria and has not yet been benchmarked against expert manual scoring. A worked example on the OSAD+ subgroup (n = 18) demonstrates pipeline output across CAP and non-CAP epochs, and a healthy-sleep A1-event HRV reference is reported from the public CAP Sleep Database (15 controls, 785 A1 epochs) as a descriptive cross-database reference. CONCLUSION: The framework provides a reproducible, rule-based, and modular tool for integrated EEG-ECG analysis of sleep microstructure and autonomic dynamics. By enabling synchronized CAP-HRV feature extraction in a single environment, it lowers the engineering barrier to brain-heart coupling research during sleep and provides a foundation for future extensions, including validated CAP detection, a matched-control study, a Python port, and cloud-based deployment.
